mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, user_id, account_id, instrument_id, symbol, side, quantity, price, executed_at FROM trades WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trades (id, order_id, user_id, account_id, instrument_id, symbol, side, quantity, price, executed_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{accountId}, #{instrumentId}, #{symbol}, #{side}, #{quantity}, #{price}, NOW())
